Shop My Account The Shakespeare on the Sound Equality & Inclusivity Statement Shakespeare on the Sound is committed to the concept that theatre is for everyone and should be accessible to all.
We believe that we are a place where Shakespeare Lives Now and need to reflect the diverse society we are a part of.
We are constantly working to include and serve all members of our society and know there is so much more work to be done.
We seek to include a diverse group of artists and theatre creators in our casting, hiring, and producing.
We are continuing to expand our education programs to those who do not have access to theatre education.
Our conversations on how to continue to serve all are ongoing and we welcome input from our community.

​ The following are local organizations fighting for racial justice Showing Up for Racial Justice (SURJ) CT CTCORE-Organize Now ACLU of Connecticut RE-Center Stamford NAACP Shakespeare on the Sound i s a proud member of the Shakespeare Theatre Association Where Shakespeare Lives Now!
